facts.business: Olympic Oil Industries Limited is an oil manufacturing company that has not carried out any business operations since FY 2019-20.

auditor.name: BHATTER & ASSOCIATES
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to sundry debtors of Rs. 316.52 crore including over dues receivable due to credit impaired of Rs. 316.52 crore, non-current investment of Rs. 4.10 crore and loan to related parties of Rs. 40.68 crore considered doubtful with no provision made. Emphasis of matter on credit facilities from banks becoming non-performing since August 2018 with no interest provided, net worth fully eroded, no business operations since FY 2019-20, and material uncertainty on going concern.

key_risks: Growth of unorganized sector and threat from local regional players
Change in freight and forwarding charges
Ability to successfully implement growth strategy
Changes in political and social conditions in India
Credit risk from sundry debtors of Rs. 316.52 crore
Liquidity risk and material uncertainty on going concern
Default in repayment of principal and interest to bankers
facts.related_party_note: Non-current investment of Rs. 4.10 crore and loan to related parties of Rs. 40.68 crore considered doubtful and recoverable by management with no provision made. Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013.
